newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Telesp to raise $310 mln abroad.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Telesp to raise $310 mln abroad.

text.p: Officials at Brazilian state-owned telecommunications firm Telesp are on a road show in the U.S. this week seeking investors for an eight-year $310 million Eurobond issue, a company director said.
The funds, which the company expects to raise by the end of this month, will be used to expand the number of cellular phone lines by 475,000, said Adroaldo Wolf, Telesp's financial director.
Telesp, a unit of federally owned Telebras serving Sao Paulo state, currently operates 500,000 cellular phone lines.
The Eurobonds will be issued by Telesp through a "special purpose company" created to raise the funds abroad, Wolf said.

Wolf also said Telesp plans to invest $2.1 billion next year to primarily expand basic and cellular telephone services. But he said the investment plan depends on approval by the Communications Ministry and Congress.
Next week, Telesp officials will head for London to meet European investors, he added.
